Sandbox_Bicycle_SpawnRate_tooltip: Percent-based multiplier applied to bicycle spawn chances. Set to 0 to disable bicycle spawns entirely.
Sandbox_Bicycle_SidecarSpawnRate_tooltip: Percent-based multiplier applied to sidecar spawn chances - both for sidecars found loose in garages, storage units, and sheds, and for sidecars rarely pre-attached to a newly spawned bicycle. Set to 0 to disable sidecar spawns entirely.
Sandbox_Bicycle_WalkSpeedMultiplier_tool: Set your player speed when riding the bicycle and not holding SHIFT.
Sandbox_Bicycle_RunSpeedMultiplier_toolt: Set your player speed when riding the bicycle and holding SHIFT.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ImmersiveMode_tooltip: When enabled you will be slower on rough surfaces unless the bicycle has a full offroad wheel setup.
Sandbox_Bicycle_AllowTransferToInventory: Allow bicycles to be transferred into the player inventory instead of only the floor or vehicle trunk.
Sandbox_Bicycle_LoadPenaltyEnabled_toolt: When enabled, attaching containers makes the bike harder to turn and heavy cargo slows it down. Disable for vanilla bike handling regardless of load.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxTurnPenalty_tooltip: Maximum reduction in turn rate when all 6 containers are attached. 0 = no turning penalty. Capped at 75%% to keep the bike usable.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxSpeedPenalty_tooltip: Maximum reduction in bike speed at 20kg of cargo inside containers. Heavy cargo slows both pedal speeds proportionally; fast pedal stays faster than slow. 0 = no speed penalty.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownEnabled_to: When riding, zombies that physically press against you slow the bike - a single bump bleeds off a little speed, and being surrounded slows you toward a near-stop. Sustained contact from a full surround also knocks you off the bike.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownStrength_t: Scales how hard contacting zombies slow you. 100 = default curve (1 zombie ~85%% speed, 4+ near stop). Lower is gentler, higher is harsher. Does not affect the knock-off.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieContactSensitivity: How close a zombie must be to count as touching. Higher widens the contact range slightly so zombies count from a touch further out; 0 requires true body overlap.
